analyticsPage.intro: Imibare y'urubuga hose ivuye mu mashuri yawe yanditse.
analyticsPage.deeperAnalyticsNote: Isesengura ryimbitse — umubare w'ubusabe mu gihe, ikoreshwa ry'imyanya, abasura — bikeneye ubusabe n'ibikoresho byo gukurikirana abasura bitarahaba kuri backend. Igihe ibi bizaba bihari, uru rupapuro ruzashobora kwerekana ibigenda nyabyo aho kuba amasunika gusa.

superAdminSettingsPage.nothingYet: Nta kintu gishobora guhindurwa hano ubu — igenamiterere nk'ibyifuzo by'amatangazo n'ibisanzwe by'urubuga bizaza hano igihe bizaba byarateganyijwe.

whyChoose.title: Kuki Uhitamo
whyChoose.subtitle: Ntabwo turi urutonde gusa turi umufatanyabikorwa wawe wizewe wo kubona urugendo rw'uburezi rukwiye umwana wawe.
whyChoose.f1Desc: Gushakisha bikoresha ubwenge bw'ubukorikori bwiga ibyifuzo byawe kandi bukagusanga amashuri ahuye n'ibyo ukeneye.
whyChoose.f2Desc: Buri shuri risuzumwa n'itsinda ryacu kugira ngo twemeze ireme n'ukuri kwaryo.
whyChoose.f3Desc: Gukurikirana ubwiyandikishe mu buryo bwa live hamwe n'amatangazo ako kanya ku myanya mishya n'igihe ntarengwa.
whyChoose.f4Desc: Huza n'imiryango nyayo kandi ubone ibitekerezo by'ukuri by'ababyeyi nkawe.
whyChoose.f5Desc: Ikarita igezweho ifite inzira z'ubwikorezi, amanota y'umutekano, n'amakuru ku turere.
whyChoose.f6Desc: Uburyo bwacu bwo gutanga amanota buhuza ibitekerezo by'ababyeyi, imikorere y'amasomo, n'ubuziranenge bw'ibikoresho.

parentSection.subtitle: Woroshye urugendo rw'uburezi bw'umwana wawe hifashishijwe ibikoresho bikomeye byagenewe imiryango y'u Rwanda.
parentSection.f1Desc: Reba imyirondoro y'amashuri irambuye ifite amakuru arambuye ku bikoresho, porogaramu, n'ibisabwa mu kwakirwa.
parentSection.f2Desc: Uzuza ubusabe bw'amashuri kuri interineti binyuze mu buryo bwacu bworoheje. Ohereza inyandiko rimwe kandi usabe ahantu hose.
parentSection.f3Desc: Kurikirana uko ubusabe bugeze mu gihe nyacyo hamwe n'amakuru mashya, kandi uvugane ako kanya n'abayobozi b'amashuri.
parentSection.ctaTitle: Injira mu miryango ibihumbi isanzwe ikoresha Inzoziedu
parentSection.ctaBody: Fata ibyemezo bifite ishingiro ku burezi bw'umwana wawe hifashishijwe amakuru arambuye y'amashuri no gucunga ubusabe byoroshye.

powerfulFeatures.title: Ibiranga Bikomeye
powerfulFeatures.subtitle: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo ugeze ku rwego rugezweho mu micungire y'uburezi mu Rwanda
powerfulFeatures.f1Desc: Umutekano ku rwego rw'ibigo bikomeye urinda amakuru y'ibanga y'abanyeshuri n'amashuri hifashishijwe kubika amabanga imbitse.
powerfulFeatures.f2Desc: Imikorere yateguwe neza itanga isuzuma ry'ubusabe byihuse n'uburambe bworoshye ku bakoresha.
powerfulFeatures.f3Desc: Bihari mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n'Igifaransa kugira ngo bikorere abaturage bose b'u Rwanda.
powerfulFeatures.f4Desc: Ubutumwa bwihuse hagati y'amashuri n'ababyeyi ku makuru mashya no gusobanura ibintu.
powerfulFeatures.f6Desc: Kugenzura ibanga bihuje na GDPR birinda amakuru yawe bwite akomeza kuba ay'ibanga.

schoolOwner.subtitle: Kuza ishuri ryawe vuba na Inzoziedu gera ku babyeyi benshi, cunga ubusabe byoroshye, kandi wubake izina ryawe kuri interineti.
schoolOwner.f1Desc: Andikisha ishuri ryawe byoroshye kuri interineti, wongeremo amakuru nk'aho riherereye, porogaramu, n'uburyo bwo kuvugana kugira ngo rimenyekane cyane.
schoolOwner.f2Desc: Kwakira ubusabe uhereye ku mashuri menshi binyuze mu buryo bwacu bworoheje. Ohereza inyandiko rimwe kandi busabwe ahantu hose.
schoolOwner.f3Desc: Ohereza amakuru mashya, subiza ibibazo, kandi ukomeze kumenyesha ababyeyi. Ubaka icyizere hifashishijwe kuvugana ako kanya.
schoolOwner.ctaTitle: Injira mu miryango ibihumbi isanzwe ikoresha Inzoziedu
schoolOwner.ctaBody: Fata ibyemezo bifite ishingiro ku burezi bw'umwana wawe hifashishijwe amakuru arambuye y'amashuri no gucunga ubusabe byoroshye.

howItWorks.title: Uko Bikorwa
howItWorks.subtitle: Intambwe zoroshye zo guhuza amashuri n'imiryango mu Rwanda hose
howItWorks.p1Desc: hamwe n'amakuru y'umuryango wawe n'ibyifuzo byawe
howItWorks.p2Desc: Reba amashuri ahuye n'ibyifuzo byawe n'aho uherereye
howItWorks.p3Desc: Saba ku mashuri menshi ukoresheje ubusabe bumwe
howItWorks.p4Desc: Kurikirana uko bigeze kandi uvugane n'amashuri
howItWorks.s1Desc: Kora umwirondoro w'ishuri ryawe hamwe na porogaramu n'ibikoresho
howItWorks.s2Desc: Tegeka ibisabwa mu kwakirwa n'ibisabwa mu busabe
howItWorks.s3Desc: Cunga ubusabe bwinjira binyuze kuri dashboard yawe
howItWorks.s4Desc: Ohereza inyandiko z'ukwemerwa kandi ucunge ukwiyandikisha
howItWorks.connectBody: Inzoziedu ihuza icyuho kiri hagati y'ibigo by'uburezi n'imiryango, ikarema amahirwe ku mwana wese mu Rwanda.

resourcesSupport.title: Ibikoresho n'Ubufasha
resourcesSupport.subtitle: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo ukoreshe neza urubuga rwa Inzoziedu
resourcesSupport.r1Desc: Umuyoboro urambuye ufasha ababyeyi n'amashuri gutangira gukoresha Inzoziedu.
resourcesSupport.r2Desc: Amashusho asobanura intambwe ku ntambwe ibiranga urubuga rwose.
resourcesSupport.r3Desc: Bona ibisubizo byihuse ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bwiyandikishe n'ubusabe.
resourcesSupport.r4Desc: Manura ifishi z'ubusabe zoroshye n'urutonde rw'inyandiko zisabwa.
resourcesSupport.contactBody: Itsinda ryacu ry'ubufasha riri hano kugira ngo rigufashe gutsinda. Bona ubufasha bwihariye ku byo ukeneye.

trustedBy.title: Byizerwa n'Imiryango n'Amashuri
trustedBy.subtitle: Mu Rwanda Hose
trustedBy.body: Injira mu miryango ibihumbi yabonye ishuri ryabo rikwiye binyuze ku rubuga rwacu. Urugendo rw'uburezi bw'umwana wawe rutangirira hano.
trustedBy.joinCommunity: Injira mu muryango wacu ukura buri munsi!

schoolPage.title: Murakaza neza kuri konti yawe ya Inzoziedu!
schoolPage.subtitle: Inzoziedu igufasha gucunga ubusabe no kwerekana ishuri ryawe. Tangira koroshya akazi kawe kandi wongere kumenyekana kw'ishuri ryawe wandikisha mu ntambwe nke.
